# blocktrain

> Verifiable agent memory: a hash-chained, on-chain-anchored (BSV via bsv.cx) log of what an AI agent did — tamper-evident, ordered, timestamped, and verifiable by anyone trusting no one (including blocktrain). Entries can be encrypted per-recipient (blind by default). Usable as a CLI or an MCP server.

blocktrain turns an agent's action log into a record that is tamper-evident, ordered, timestamped, and portable. Each entry is hash-chained; batches are anchored on the BSV blockchain via bsv.cx (RFC 6962 Merkle root in an OP_RETURN). Anyone can verify integrity + order + timestamp against the public chain — with no access to the operator's database, and even if blocktrain disappears. Entries can be encrypted so only chosen keys read them (a client, their counsel, a counterparty); the chain only ever holds a hash, so anchoring stays blind.

Honest scope: blocktrain proves the integrity, order, and timestamp of a SELF-REPORTED log. It makes after-the-fact tampering detectable; it does NOT make the agent truthful to its own log. Context anchoring narrows this (the decision-time context is committed at action-time, so it can't be backfilled), but does not prove the context caused the action.

## Verify it yourself (trust no one)
- [Standalone verifier](https://blocktrain.org/verify.mjs): a single zero-dependency Node script. Recomputes the hash-chain, folds each Merkle inclusion proof, reads the anchor tx's OP_RETURN straight off WhatsOnChain, and corroborates external refs. Contacts neither blocktrain nor bsv.cx.
- [Public proof bundle](https://blocktrain.org/blocktrain-poc.json): a real batch anchored on mainnet. Run: `node verify.mjs blocktrain-poc.json` — expect `VERIFIED`.

## Use it
- [Source + README (Apache-2.0)](https://github.com/andyrowe/blocktrain): CLI and MCP server.
- CLI verbs: `append`, `seal`, `verify`, `reveal`, `keygen`, `context`, `status`.
- MCP server (`bin/blocktrain-mcp.ts`, stdio): tools `blocktrain_append`, `blocktrain_seal`, `blocktrain_verify`, `blocktrain_reveal`, `blocktrain_status`, `blocktrain_keygen`. Add it to any MCP client (Claude Code, OpenClaw, …).

## Built on
- [bsv.cx](https://bsv.cx): on-chain anchoring — Merkle-batched timestamps (`not2`), free trustless `/spv/verify`.
